key_idea: Lia threw more arrows than she started with, and each hit gave her 3 of them.
steps: Lia threw 21 arrows but started with only 9.
Each hit gives 3 arrows. 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12, so she hit the target 4 times.

choice_feedback.A: 3 hits give 9 extra arrows. Then she could throw only 9 + 9 = 18.
choice_feedback.C: 5 hits give 15 extra arrows. Then she could throw 9 + 15 = 24.
choice_feedback.D: 6 hits give 18 extra arrows. Then she could throw 9 + 18 = 27.
choice_feedback.E: 8 hits give 24 extra arrows. Then she could throw 9 + 24 = 33.
